subject: Merchant VAT ID bulk cleanse and rebilling plan
messages:
From: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@mercurypay.io>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: tax@mercurypay.io, anna.muller@mercurypay.io
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: VAT IDs flagged on June invoices — bulk request

Hi Olga,

Thanks for taking this. We ran a reconciliation this morning and found ~1,400 invoices in June flagged for VAT mismatch or missing VAT IDs. A subset of ~220 are EU-B2B with reverse-charge potential but were billed gross. Our accounting team can't proceed with reclaim until we get corrected invoices with the proper VAT treatment and references.

Attached is a CSV from our side (mercurypay_vat_failed_list.csv) with invoice IDs, reported VAT ID, country, and suggested place of supply. Can Redwood do a bulk validation + reissue where applicable? We need:
- Batch VAT ID validation against VIES (and log)
- Identify invoices that should be reverse-charged vs. gross VAT
- Reissue corrected invoices for net/reverse-charge where valid
- Unlock payment collection for cleared invoices (we can re-open payment for those we confirm)

Timing: end of month audit on July 9. Can you give an ETA and whether there will be any billing impact (credits/adjustments)?

Best,
Liam
Head of Billing Ops, MercuryPay

From: olga.petrov@redwood.ai <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@mercurypay.io>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 11:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: VAT IDs flagged on June invoices — bulk request

Hi Liam — thanks for the CSV and concise ask. High-level plan below. I copied Ben / Payments (Neha) and Finance (Jonas) to scope operational tasks.

Proposed next steps (we can run today afternoon):
1) Run automated VIES + local registry checks for the 1,400 rows and produce a verification log.
2) Mark the ~220 EU-B2B candidates and run reverse-charge logic rules (country of customer, VAT ID valid, billing entity).
3) For invoices where reverse-charge applies, generate credit + replace invoice net of VAT and include reverse-charge wording.
4) For invalid VAT IDs, add a payment hold and send template evidence request to the customer (we'll use a short-note email).
5) Provide a migration plan for your AR team to accept reissued invoices and instructions for refund/collection flow.

Ben — can you confirm if sales credits are allowed for this cohort or if we should always issue a net replace invoice + credit?
Neha — can Payments accept a bulk unlock via API once we push a CSV of cleared invoice IDs?
Jonas — we'll need a one-time journal entry format for net adjustment vs VAT credit.

ETA: initial validation report by EOD today (Thu). Reissue batch: by Tue 30 Jun if approvals align.

Regards,
Olga
Senior Revenue Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

From: ben.carter@redwood.ai <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 11:37:00 +0000
Subject: Re: VAT IDs flagged on June invoices — bulk request

Quick note — from sales side we prefer corrected invoices (credit + reissue) rather than unilateral write-offs. Keeps ledgers clean and supports your reclaim. No discretionary credits unless there is a customer-initiated dispute.

I'll loop in Customer Success if any customers contest reissued totals.
Ben
Senior Account Exec
Redwood Inference

From: olga.petrov@redwood.ai <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@mercurypay.io>, tax@mercurypay.io
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 14:58:00 +0000
Subject: RE: VAT IDs flagged on June invoices — bulk request

Hi Liam — attached the validation output and the rebilling template (rebill_template-OLGA-v1.pdf). Summary:
- Total rows checked: 1,412
- Validated VAT IDs (VIES positive): 1,153
- Invalid/missing VAT IDs: 259
- EU-B2B candidates where reverse-charge should apply: 198 (we flagged country mismatches and entity mapping)

Proposal for the 198: we will issue credit notes and reissue net invoices with the reverse-charge clause. For the 259 invalid IDs we will keep invoices on hold and send a one-line evidence request to the tax contact (tax@mercurypay.io).

Action items:
- MercuryPay: confirm you approve reissue for the 198 (we will not alter amounts apart from removing VAT). Approve by EOD Wed 1 Jul to hit Tue reissue.
- Redwood Payments (Neha): once MercuryPay approves, accept a bulk unlock API call for invoice IDs listed in the attached doc_HUBSPOT-9842.txt.
- Redwood Finance (Jonas): we will push a journal with credits and reissue amounts; template attached in Drive link.

If we receive approval, we'll schedule rebill window Tue 6 Jul 02:00-04:00 UTC to minimize disruption.

Thanks,
Olga

--Attachment stubs: mercurypay_vat_failed_list.csv (CSV), rebill_template-OLGA-v1.pdf (PDF), doc_HUBSPOT-9842.txt (TXT)--

From: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@mercurypay.io>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: tax@mercurypay.io, anna.muller@mercurypay.io, ben.carter@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2026 15:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: VAT IDs flagged on June invoices — bulk request

Thank you — MercuryPay approves the proposed flow. Please proceed with the reissue window on Tue 6 Jul (the window you suggested) and include verification logs for each invoice. For the invalid IDs, we'll coordinate evidence responses internally and will update your team.

Two quick clarifications:
1) Will reissued invoices keep the same invoice numbers with a suffix or receive new numbers? Our AP team wants a clear audit trail.
2) For customers who already paid the gross VAT amounts, can you confirm Redwood will produce a credit note that offsets the original and a new net invoice so our payment reconciliation matches?

If you can confirm both, we'll notify our AR and unblock the audit.

Best,
Liam
